global: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its rich, amber broth glistening under warm light. Topped with menma and green onions, it sits in a white bowl with Japanese script, resting on a wooden table.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black Japanese characters, smooth surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle glaze finish.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions and meat, appears rich, orange-brown, and glossy.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, with a slightly rough, fibrous texture and curved, segmented shapes.
